verdict.rationale: Typesense is a search engine. It is a data and tool provider for AI agents, not an agent that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error. The evidence describes only the opposite role: a Typesense Cloud MCP server that agents connect to (typesense-docs-43, typesense-docs-52). That server-side capability is not credited here, and nothing shows Typesense acting as an MCP client.
